text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Crisp clear skies! The scent of the sea 
breeze! Now this is summer camp, yes sir!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Totally! —Whoops, mind if I move 
everyone's luggage over here for a sec?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You got it! But we'll be unpacking right 
away, so doing it roughly is totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Oops! Look, it's almost meeting time. 
Let's get going, everyone—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Did that rub off on you? Sorry, it's 
just a habit of mine!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh? What is it, what is it?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, enough already! Come on, let's 
hurry up and go!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, another lively summer training 
camp got underway.
